title: Neon Crave
style: sensual futuristic deep techno, 120 BPM, smooth seductive female vocals with light breathy reverb, warm rolling bass, dreamy atmospheric pads, hypnotic elegant groove, late-night city romance vibe, cinematic and intimate, clean production, DJ Zyn g4 lens
lyrics:
[Intro]
(Deep warm sub + shimmering neon pads)
City haze… pulling me in…
[Verse 1]
Purple glow sliding over your skin
Eyes like trouble, drawing me in
Slow motion when you move my way
One look and I’m already lost
[Pre-Chorus]
Heart beating with the bassline
No escape from this tonight
[Chorus]
I got that neon crave
Running wild through my veins
You’re the high I can’t behave
Pull me close, let it rain
Neon crave… neon crave…
Dancing in the dark with you
[Hook]
Skin on skin under the lights
No words, just the heat we ignite
Neon crave… take me higher
Neon crave… set me on fire
[Verse 2]
Leather scent mixing with the smoke
Your voice low, got me ready to choke
Secret glances cutting through the crowd
We both know what’s coming now
[Bridge]
(Soft vocal chops + rising tension)
Take it higher… feel the fire
Let the night swallow us whole
No tomorrow, only this moment
Give me all your control
[Final Chorus]
I got that neon crave
Running wild through my veins
You’re the high I can’t behave
Pull me close, let it rain
Neon crave… neon crave…
[Outro]
Neon crave… fading slow
Neon crave… let it flow…
